name: today
description: START HERE for 'what do I need to do?'. Everything due in the next N days (default 14) from every system at once: Canvas deadlines not yet submitted, Ladok registration windows open now or opening soon, this week's timetable, and (library=true) library loans due back. Each section reports its own error, so one dead session never hides the rest.

name: doctor
description: Health check of every session the toolkit depends on (Canvas token and its expiry date, agent browser, Ladok, database proxy, library, timetable link). Each row has the fix, which is always a human action. Run it when another tool fails. only='canvas,ladok' limits the checks.

name: schedule
description: Timetable for any course code (1SPRY2), student group (H26SK) or room, for any period, from TimeEdit without a login. kind=code|group|room|subject. start/end as YYYY-MM-DD or TimeEdit relative form (0.d = today, 4.w = four weeks). Course NAMES are not indexed: search the code or the group.

name: free_rooms
description: Which student-bookable rooms are free on a date (default today), as gaps between bookings within the booking rules (Mon-Fri 08-20, up to 3 days ahead, max 4 h). Read-only: booking itself is done by the student in TimeEdit.

name: library
description: The school library (Koha). With query: catalogue search with availability per copy. Without: the student's own loans with due dates and days left, holds and fines.

name: ladok_windows
description: Ladok registration windows (kursregistrering + tentamensanmälan): what opens when, what closes within N days, with course period. Needs the agent Chrome logged in to Ladok (CDP :9233); read-only, never registers anything. Subrepo: ladok_vakt/.

name: courses
description: List the student's Canvas courses: id, code, name, term.

name: discussions
description: Discussion topics across courses with read state and reply count, so a group discussion that is waiting for an answer does not go unnoticed. Announcements are separate.

course.description: Canvas course id; omitted: every active course

days.description: Only topics replied to in the last N days; omitted: all

name: announcements
description: Course announcements, newest first, with body text. Canvas hides these from the plain discussion list, so this is the only way to see what a teacher posted.

course.description: Canvas course id; omitted: every active course

name: upcoming
description: Everything due from today across all Canvas courses: title, course, due (UTC), submitted. Start here for 'what is due?'.

name: mirror
description: Download a whole Canvas course (modules, pages, assignments with rubrics, announcements, discussions, files) to disk. course='all' mirrors every course.

name: canvas_get
description: Raw Canvas REST GET with pagination, e.g. path='courses/123/assignments'. params is a JSON object of query parameters.

name: assignment
description: One Canvas assignment with description and rubric as plain text.

name: login_check
description: Which SSO sites (Canvas, SharePoint, Ladok) the agent browser is logged in to.

name: page
description: Rendered text of any page, read through the student's logged-in browser (SharePoint, Ladok, Inspera, intranet).

name: fetch
description: JSON/text fetch executed inside `origin` so the site's own cookies apply. Use for internal APIs (Ladok student API, SharePoint REST).

name: sharepoint_download
description: Download a SharePoint share link (/:b:/ or /:u:/ style) to a local file; returns path, size, type.

name: search
description: Full-text search inside one course: pages, assignments with rubrics, modules, discussions, files. Operators: "phrase", -exclude, +required, OR, type:sida|uppgift|fil|modul|diskussion, filetype:pdf, intitle:word, before:YYYY-MM-DD, after:YYYY-MM-DD, plus regex/fuzzy toggles. source='mirror' searches a local mirror (fast, may be stale), 'api' fetches live from Canvas, 'auto' prefers the mirror. include_docs=true also searches the document text built by the docs tool.

name: docs
description: Download a course's files once, extract their text (pdf, docx, pptx, xlsx, html, images) and cache it keyed by file id + updated_at. Bytes are discarded, text is kept. ocr=true adds tesseract for documents with no usable text layer; it is slow, so it is not part of a normal index run.

name: surface
description: Probe which Canvas endpoints a student session can reach, before building anything on assumptions. Returns per-endpoint status, item count and payload size, plus a summary of what is blocked (pages index, quizzes and rubrics are commonly off).

name: programme
description: Map the whole SHH nursing programme: every course with its kursplan and kurslitteraturlista downloaded and verified by the course code inside each file.

name: timeedit
description: Bookings from a TimeEdit schedule link (the .html URL the student copies from TimeEdit). Returns date, start, end and the booking columns. Note: a link covers only the period it was created for.

name: koha_search
description: Search the SHH library catalogue (Koha, biblioteket.shh.se) for course books and literature: title, biblionumber and availability per hit. Read-only. Goes through the proxied agent browser because the library's Cloudflare refuses plain HTTP clients.

name: koha_item
description: One catalogue record by biblionumber: item table (placering, status, item type) and the record summary (publisher, edition, language). Read-only.

name: koha_loans
description: Your own Koha account: loans with due dates and reservations with queue position. Needs ~/.secrets/KOHA_USER and ~/.secrets/KOHA_PIN (you create them; never printed). Read-only: no renewal, no reservation changes.

name: koha_open_login
description: Open the library account page in the proxied Chrome window and report whether the session is signed in. For the one-time manual sign-in; after that koha_loans reads the account from the session cookie.

name: koha_wait_login
description: Wait until the library account page shows a signed-in session, for the one-time manual sign-in in the proxied Chrome window. After that koha_loans needs no credentials.

name: koha_status
description: Diagnostics for the Koha path: whether the proxied browser and the local chain proxy are up, and whether library credentials are on file.

name: db_list
description: List the subscription databases Sophiahemmet gives access to (CINAHL, PsycInfo, Cochrane, Web of Science, JCR, Sage Research Methods, NE, PubMed) and whether each one can be searched from here.

name: db_status
description: Check whether the school sign-in still works for a database (default cinahl). authenticated=false means the Entra session expired and someone has to sign in once in the school browser.

name: db_search
description: Search a subscription database (cinahl, psycinfo) and return citations: title, authors, journal, year, volume, issue, pages, subjects, peer-reviewed, full-text, record URL. A bare multi-word query is joined with AND; quotes keep a phrase.

name: db_detail
description: Open one database record and return its abstract, DOI, authors and source line. Pass the record URL from db_search.

name: db_open
description: Open one database in the school browser and report where it landed. For the databases that have no structured search here (Cochrane, Web of Science, JCR, Sage, NE) and for signing in when the session has expired.

name: db_fulltext
description: Full text of one article, by DOI, through the school's subscription (EZproxy). Saves the PDF under ~/.local/share/unitoolkit/fulltext and returns path, pages and the extracted text. Says why when there is no route (publisher outside the proxy: order it via fjärrlån; or an open-access copy exists). Capped at 20 downloads an hour: the licences allow reading for study, not bulk downloading.

name: find_sources
description: THE citation tool: one query across several databases (default cinahl, pubmed, cochrane; also psycinfo, wos), deduplicated by DOI, each hit with an APA 7 reference built from the publisher's own DOI metadata. Use this for 'find me sources on X'.

name: apa
description: APA 7 reference for a DOI, from the DOI registry (not from scraped pages). lang='sv' for svensk APA wording.

name: pubmed
description: Search PubMed. Returns PMID, title, journal, year, authors, DOI.

name: libris
description: Search Libris (Swedish union catalogue) for books: title, author, year, publisher, ISBN. Use to verify a course-book reference.

name: refs_search
description: Search clinician-side Swedish reference sites. site='vardhandboken'. Matches the sitemap page paths, then returns the top hits with title, source URL, fetch date and a snippet. Read a full page with refs_page. Internetmedicin is not supported (its robots.txt excludes crawlers); FASS product pages need a browser (use `page`).

name: refs_page
description: One clinician-side reference page as text (Vårdhandboken, Läkemedelsboken, Janusinfo, Viss). Returns url, title, fetched date and text. Cached on disk; refuses hosts and paths their robots.txt disallows.
